references.text: Israel abandoned God who created them and despised the Rock of their salvation - the same theme of abandoning God
Joshua warns that God will turn away and bring disaster if the people abandon him and serve foreign gods
Israel abandoned the Lord and served Baal and the goddesses of Ashtoreth - the same pattern of apostasy described
Samuel says that the people have abandoned God and served other gods ever since they came out of Egypt
The people confess that they have sinned by abandoning the Lord and serving Baal and Ashtoreth
Israel sinned against the Lord by serving other gods - a summary of the same type of apostasy
Because the people abandoned the Lord, he has abandoned them - the same consequence of apostasy
The people have abandoned the Lord, the source of living water, and hewn out cisterns that cannot hold water - a prophetic lament over apostasy
Moses prophesies that the people will turn to foreign gods and God will hide his face from them
God reminds Israel of his deliverance from Egypt and warned them against worshiping foreign gods
